issue.title: bob gmail: mail notes you choose, linked from tasks, sent through Gmail drafts
issue.description: A Gmail link in a capture, a paste, or a picker becomes a labelled link to an inert, beautifully rendered, append-only mail note in the vault; replies and new mail are written in Obsidian and sent only through a previewed, confirmed Gmail draft; the phone feeds the vault through a `bob` label — all without capture ever touching the network and without sender text ever executing in the vault.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/bob_gmail.md requests this work
